verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of consent features such as participant recording notifications, in-meeting disclosure prompts, or admin-enforced transparency settings. Audit logs and SSO are adjacent admin controls, not consent mechanisms. Community reports describe default transcript sharing and users learning of a recording only from the post-meeting summary email, which is incidental behavior rather than a consent feature. The documented bot-free desktop recording, if anything, cuts against in-meeting disclosure.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF
